payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Turn on the ways your customers can pay — they all work together and the buyer picks one at checkout. CRM never touches the money: payments flow straight to your provider account, and refunds go through the provider's API when you handle returns.
payments.connectToEnable: Connect this gateway to accept card payments

offline.hintManual: Cash, bank transfer or pay-on-delivery. The order is recorded; no card is charged online.
offline.hintOther: Any other gateway (Kaspi, your own payment link, a bank). The order is recorded; you collect the payment yourself and confirm it.
offline.displayNameHint: What the customer sees at checkout.
offline.instructionsHint: Shown on the order-confirmation screen so the buyer knows how to pay. E.g. "Send the total to Kaspi +7 700 123 4567 and reply with the receipt photo."
offline.instrPhManual: Pay the courier in cash on delivery.
offline.instrPhOther: Send the total to Kaspi +7 …, then reply with the receipt.

providers.stripe: Global card payments — 50+ countries, Stripe Payment Intents + Refunds API
providers.apipay: Kaspi payments via ApiPay — async push to the buyer's Kaspi app (needs a connected Kaspi cashier). KZT only
providers.halyk_epay: Card payments via Halyk Bank ePay — hosted page (PCI-light), KZT, server-verified status
providers.cloudpayments: Card payments via TipTop Pay (ex-CloudPayments) — popup widget (PCI-light), KZT/RUB, Refunds API
providers.robokassa: Card payments via Robokassa — hosted redirect page (PCI-light), KZT, server-verified status
providers.paypal: PayPal — redirect checkout (Orders v2). For international buyers; does NOT support KZT (USD/EUR/…)
providers.manual: No API integration — cash, bank transfer, etc. Refunds are record-only
providers.other: Free-form provider — record references manually in Returns workflow

beta.body: This payment method is fully built and unit-tested, but not yet verified end-to-end with real money — so it can misbehave. If something doesn't work, tell us and we'll fix it fast. It will work reliably soon.

cabinet.title: URLs for the {{name}} cabinet
cabinet.hint: Copy these into {{name}}'s technical settings — no need to type them by hand.
cabinet.noSite: Set this store's site URL (Authentication → URL config) to fill the Success / Fail links.

purpose.robokassa: Result URL is required — the gateway POSTs the payment result there. Success / Fail are where the buyer returns after paying. Homepage is your store's front page.
purpose.apipay: Paste this Webhook URL into your ApiPay dashboard (Settings → Connection → Webhooks). ApiPay POSTs payment events there. When you create the webhook you'll get a Webhook Secret — put that in the Webhook Secret field above.

panel.modeTestHint: No real money will be charged — use the provider's test cards.
panel.modeLiveHint: Real card charges will be made. Switch to test mode for development.
panel.activeHint: Show this gateway at checkout. Turn off to pause it — your keys stay saved.
panel.stripeRecommended: Connect via Stripe OAuth instead of pasting keys — safer + revocable from your Stripe dashboard.
panel.accountLabelHint: Shown to your team in the Returns refund step — e.g. "Torta Cakes — main account".
panel.dashboardUrlHint: Quick link from the Returns modal to your provider's refund page.

panel.savedValue: Saved value. Type a new one to replace.
panel.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this payment provider? Stored credentials will be erased.
panel.stripeInvalidRedirect: Stripe Connect returned an invalid redirect URL.

hint.stripe: Process card payments globally. Test mode keys work without real money.
hint.apipay: Enter your ApiPay API Key (apipay.kz dashboard → API Keys; sent as the X-API-Key header) and optionally the Webhook Secret. Connect your Kaspi cashier in the ApiPay dashboard (Settings → Kaspi Authorization). The buyer enters their phone; ApiPay pushes the charge to their Kaspi app and we confirm server-side. KZT only.
hint.halyk_epay: Enter your Halyk ePay Client ID + Secret + Terminal ID. The buyer pays on Halyk's hosted page; we confirm via check-status server-side. KZT only.
hint.cloudpayments: Enter your TipTop Pay (ex-CloudPayments) Public ID + API Secret from the cabinet (merchant.tiptoppay.kz). The buyer pays in a popup widget; we confirm the charge server-side. Test mode uses your test keys.
hint.robokassa: Enter your Robokassa Merchant login + Password #1 and #2 (and hash algorithm — md5 by default). In your Robokassa cabinet set the Result URL to your store's …/payments/robokassa/result endpoint and the Success/Fail URLs to your store's /checkout/return. The buyer pays on Robokassa's page; we confirm via the OpState status check.
hint.paypal: Enter your PayPal app Client ID + Secret (PayPal Developer dashboard). The buyer is redirected to PayPal to approve, then we capture + confirm the payment server-side on return. ⚠️ PayPal can't charge KZT — set your store currency to USD/EUR. Test mode uses your sandbox credentials.
hint.manual: No API. Orders recorded as payment_status="manual", refunds are record-only — you process money externally (cash / bank transfer).
hint.other: For providers we haven't integrated. You'll need to manually record references in the Returns workflow.
